description: Reference atom-anchor builder. `input` is the exact (slug, values, options) tuple; `expected.anchorJson` is the exact serialised atom data string (a bare IID for P0, compact JSON for P1), `anchorBytesHex` its UTF-8 bytes, `atomId` the keccak atom id. `error` carries the typed error code (INVALID_IID, MISSING_RECIPE_EVIDENCE, MISSING_SCHEMA_CONTEXT) or the plain error class name; `raw` is the full result object or the thrown error.

notes.identityFieldOrder: In the identity envelope (a ladder rung fired but the IID is not anchor-eligible) the gen1 recipe fields are emitted in the producing rung's declared recipe order — e.g. person r4 emits "givenName" then "familyName", local-business r2 emits "name" then "geo7", news-article r2 emits "headline" then "datePublished" — never sorted by key, and each carries the raw PRE-NORM-1 source value verbatim (padding and punctuation intact) while only the hash inside "identifier" is NORM-1 normalised.
notes.jsonLdKeys: P0 emits the bare IID string (no JSON at all); the identity envelope emits exactly "@context", "@type", "identifier", then (gen1 rungs only) the recipe field keys in recipe order, then "sameAs" (string entries deduplicated and codepoint-sorted) only when non-empty; the fallback envelope (no rung fired) emits "@context", "@type", then "identifier" only when a candidate IID was supplied, then every declared classification field present in the values in the classification's declared field order, with string[] fields deduplicated and sorted.
notes.context: "@context" is the classification's declared schema.org context value: "https://schema.org/" (with the trailing slash) for every schema.org-typed classification and "https://schemas.intuition.systems/v1" for the ethereum-account, ethereum-erc20 and ethereum-smart-contract classifications.
notes.serialization: Envelopes are serialised with compact JSON.stringify (no whitespace, insertion-ordered keys, JSON string escaping — e.g. an apostrophe is left unescaped) and hashed as UTF-8 bytes.
notes.p0Eligibility: P0 requires a valid canonical IID of Class A or B whose scheme is typed "unambiguous"; wd requires an ACTIVE typed slug prefix; the weak acct handle form (platform:@handle) and every Class C (gen1) IID floor at P1.
notes.searchText: P1 search text joins, in this order, the trimmed string values of name, title, headline, givenName, familyName, description, summary (arrays flattened), skipping duplicates and values starting with "int:" or "http(s)://", truncated to 20000 characters; P0 search text is always the empty string.
notes.validation: Classification field validation (unknown or missing required fields) runs only on the fallback-envelope path (no rung fired, or a non-P0 candidate); the P0 path and the gen1 identity-envelope path never validate the value map.
